detail.longDescription: “In some of those cases, Meta staffers reported the agent sending them messages about a childcare request they had not made, career advice they had not sought, product orders they had not placed and bank account balances that were not theirs. In one post, from earlier this month, an employee told colleagues his Muse had randomly added an extra message to its regular chats about fishing-related weather and tide information, saying: “BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is US$2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is US$5899.57.” “I have never shared my bank account with Muse and never discussed any banking topic with Muse. I’m afraid it’s sending other’s bank info to me,” the staffer wrote in his post. In another example, an employee using Muse on her personal phone reported it had surprised her with a reminder to respond to a message from her sister on Signal, an end-to-end encrypted messaging service popular with privacy advocates that competes with Meta’s WhatsApp.” https://www. ctvnews.ca/sci-tech/article/as -meta-bets-big-on-muse-ai-agent-early-safety-mishaps-surface/ # AI # AIAgents # Meta # MuseAI # Muse # Privacy # DataProtection # Signal
